_comment: AUV1P torpedo. Body frame: x forward, y starboard (right), z down. Every number here is a first estimate from the CAD (1480 mm hex rods, 180 mm chambers) and Blue Robotics datasheets - replace with measured values as they arrive.

hull._displaced_volume_note: pi*(0.09^2)*1.5 = 0.0382 m3 -> 374.6 N of buoyancy at 1000 kg/m3, vs 372.8 N weight: floats very slowly when idle. Trim this to match the float test.
hull._bg_note: metacentric height: centre of buoyancy this far ABOVE centre of gravity. Bigger = stiffer in roll/pitch.

added_mass._comment: fraction of rigid mass / inertia dragged along with the hull

drag._comment: quadratic drag  F = -0.5*rho*Cd*A*|v|*v  per body axis; rotational: M = -(lin*w + quad*w*|w|)

stern_thruster._comment: T200 on ~4S. Output MAIN 8 (servo 8). effort e in -1..1 -> thrust = max*e*|e| with first-order lag

bow_thruster._comment: T200 in a tunnel near the nose, pushing sideways (+y for +effort). Output AUX 1 (servo 9).

fins._comment: Four fins in '+' at the stern. top/bottom are vertical surfaces (force along body y), left/right are horizontal (force along body z). force_sign = direction of force for a POSITIVE deflection, i.e. the physical meaning the bench SIGNS table in fin_mixer.py has to match.
fins._cl_note: isolated fin of aspect ratio ~1.5 gives ~2.7/rad; the hull acts as an end-plate so the effective aspect ratio roughly doubles -> ~3.5/rad. Measure at the pool.
